name: Ski Resort
overview: Reliable and fair Misha has been working all his life as a crane operator in the port of the small provincial town of Zavodskoy. When the port owner once again fails to pay the workers' salaries, Misha stands up for his colleagues — and naturally remains unemployed. Misha has a blockhead son, Timur, around his neck — a carefree adventurer who does not miss the opportunity to earn "easy money", but every time he fails and accumulates debts. Trying to stay afloat, Misha miraculously gets a job at an elite ski resort. Everything is arranged strictly here: team discipline, routine, different characters and a variety of tasks that need to be handled on the go — from everyday trivia to conflicts with inspectors and sometimes with guests.
